html.body: Date: 2025-04-23 U.S. Application No. 17/881,061 Amendment Under 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 REMARKSThe Office has issued a Notice of Allowance for this application. The Applicant submits this amendment and requests entry thereof pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 1.312. Specifically, by way of this amendment, paragraphs [0031] and [0058] of the specification has been amended to correct typographical errors. Claims 11, 18, 20, 29, 31, and 32 have been amended to correct antecedent basis and claim 23 has been amended to correct its dependency. All claims are supported by the specification. No new matter has been added. Accordingly, the Applicant respectfully requests entry of this amendment into the present application before issuance thereof.The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency in the amount enclosed or any additional fees that may be required during the pendency of this application under 37 C.F.R. § 1.16 or § 1.17 and/or in connection with payment of the issue fee to Deposit Account 50-2455. Please refund any overpayment to Hanley, Flight & Zimmerman, LLC at the address below.Respectfully submitted, HANLEY, FLIGHT & ZIMMERMAN, LLCAttorneys for Applicant USPTO Customer No. 101302 10 South Wacker Drive, Suite 3500 Chicago, Illinois 60606 (312) 580-1020 April 23, 2025 By: /Marianne Buckley/ Marianne Buckley Registration No. 68,104 - 11 -
